rci1_using_msad.detail: Multi-center datasets; DIDA-MDD (discovery) has 9 research sites; REST-meta-MDD (validation) has 25 research sites. Both multi-site datasets are used for normative model construction.
rci1_using_msad.supporting_text: "This study included two extensive multi-center datasets comprising 2424 patients with MDD and 2183 HCs sourced from the Disease Imaging Data Archiving-Major Depressive Disorder Working Group (DIDA-MDD) and REST-meta-MDD consortium. The DIDA-MDD encompassed nine research sites"; "The validation dataset was sourced from the REST-meta-MDD consortium (http://rfmri.org/REST-meta-MDD) (Chen et al., 2022; Yan et al., 2019), comprising 25 research sites"
rci1_using_msad.location: Han2024B.pdf.md: Methods / Samples, L77; Han2024B.pdf.md: Methods / Samples, L85

rci2_using_epd.detail: REST-meta-MDD is in the EPD list (6 uses). REST-meta-MDD HCs (N=1104) are used to build normative models in the validation analysis. DIDA-MDD (discovery dataset, not in EPD list) HCs are used for the main normative model training.
rci2_using_epd.supporting_text: "The validation dataset was sourced from the REST-meta-MDD consortium (http://rfmri.org/REST-meta-MDD) (Chen et al., 2022; Yan et al., 2019), comprising 25 research sites with 1276 patients diagnosed with MDD (age: 36.23 ± 21.378 years, females: 63.71%) and 1104 HCs (age: 36.15 ± 24.552 years, females: 58.06%)"; "training a Gaussian process regression model based on HCs in the discovery dataset and applying it to HCs in the validation dataset, and vice versa"
rci2_using_epd.location: Han2024B.pdf.md: Methods / Samples, L85; Han2024B.pdf.md: Methods / Modeling individualized ALFF abnormalities, L97

rci3_epd_name.detail: REST-meta-MDD consortium HCs used as reference cohort for normative modeling in the validation analysis. DIDA-MDD is not an EPD.
rci3_epd_name.supporting_text: "The validation dataset was sourced from the REST-meta-MDD consortium (http://rfmri.org/REST-meta-MDD) (Chen et al., 2022; Yan et al., 2019), comprising 25 research sites with 1276 patients diagnosed with MDD (age: 36.23 ± 21.378 years, females: 63.71%) and 1104 HCs (age: 36.15 ± 24.552 years, females: 58.06%)"

rci5_n.detail: Training phase HCs; model-1 from DIDA-MDD (9 sites) after quality control; model-2 from REST-meta-MDD (25 sites) used for replication/validation normative modeling.
rci5_n.supporting_text: "Following rigorous quality control for both clinical and imaging data (Sun et al., 2023), the final sample included 1148 patients with MDD (age: 33.83 ± 22.17 years, females: 58.62%) and 1079 HCs (age: 33.96 ± 19.25 years, females: 56.81%)."; "The validation dataset was sourced from the REST-meta-MDD consortium (http://rfmri.org/REST-meta-MDD) (Chen et al., 2022; Yan et al., 2019), comprising 25 research sites with 1276 patients diagnosed with MDD (age: 36.23 ± 21.378 years, females: 63.71%) and 1104 HCs (age: 36.15 ± 24.552 years, females: 58.06%)."
rci5_n.location: Han2024B.pdf.md: Methods / Samples, L77; Han2024B.pdf.md: Methods / Samples, L85

rci6_sex.detail: Training phase; female_n estimated from reported female percentage × total N (model-1: 1079 × 56.81% ≈ 613; model-2: 1104 × 58.06% ≈ 641). Male_n derived by subtraction.
